# MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

Scope
- This procedure covers fastener inspection, lubrication, and torque control for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02). It applies to bolted and threaded assemblies that affect structural integrity, safety interlocks, quench system, and process-critical components on EQ-P2-L4-HT02.
- This document supplements MM-P2-L4-HT02 and operational guidance in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-04. When torque values or tightening sequences are required but not specified here, follow the referenced documents or the component manufacturer’s instructions.

Background and rationale
- Fastener condition and correct preload are essential to maintain alignment of heating elements, seals on the quench chamber, and reliable actuation of safety devices. Improper torque or degraded fasteners can produce misalignment, leaks, or electrical discontinuities that lead to process excursions or equipment damage.
- Lubrication of threaded interfaces reduces friction variability and improves repeatability of achieved preload. Use the approved lubricant part number CFW-LUB-426. Using any other lubricant may change torque-to-preload relationships and void conformity with maintenance records.
- Quench timing impacts thermal shock and component stresses. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 10 seconds. Fastener-related failures that change thermal mass or distortion can influence quench performance; inspect fasteners where dimensional change would affect the quench path.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench and appropriate socket/bit set compatible with fastener heads on EQ-P2-L4-HT02. Verify calibration status per plant calibration program and the guidance in MM-P2-L4-HT02.
- Thread-cleaning tools (wire brush, thread chaser) for disassembly where corrosion or debris is present.
- Solvent and lint-free cloths for cleaning clamped surfaces prior to torque.
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-426.
- Inspection magnifier and dye-penetrant kit or equivalent for crack detection where visual inspection is inconclusive.
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-04.

Procedure
Preparation
1. Lockout/tagout EQ-P2-L4-HT02 per SOP-P2-L4-01 before any fastener work. Confirm energy isolation and verify the furnace is at a safe state for mechanical work.
2. Review MM-P2-L4-HT02 for equipment-specific assemblies and any documented tightening sequences. If MM-P2-L4-HT02 references a manufacturer sequence, use that sequence.

Inspection
3. Visually inspect fastener heads and washers for corrosion, rounded corners, fretting, or evidence of loosening (gap, paint lines broken).
4. Where visible damage or cracking is suspected, perform a detailed inspection using magnifier and dye-penetrant. Record findings on the maintenance record.
5. For assemblies affecting quench chamber integrity or load-bearing connections, ensure no distortion of mating surfaces. Clean contact faces with solvent and ensure they are dry and free of debris.

Cleaning and preparation
6. If threads are contaminated, use a thread chaser or brush to remove debris. Do not rework damaged threads beyond cleaning; replace the fastener if integrity is compromised.
7. Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-426 to the male threads only where the design requires lubrication. Wipe excess from bearing surfaces; avoid contaminating seals and electrical contacts.

Tightening
8. Follow the tightening sequence documented in MM-P2-L4-HT02 or the manufacturer procedure. If a sequence is not specified in those documents, use a symmetrical approach working across the flange or assembly to distribute load evenly.
9. Use the calibrated torque wrench to apply torque. Do not apply impact tools where preload consistency is required.
10. For assemblies that require verification of preload after thermal cycles or commissioning, include follow-up checks per MM-P2-L4-HT02.

Examples and notes
- Example: For a multi-bolt flange, tighten in a star or cross pattern to bring all bolts to snug condition before final torque. The star pattern prevents uneven seating and minimizes flange distortion.
- Use CFW-LUB-426 on threads where the assembly documentation allows. Document lubricant application to maintain traceability.
- If any fastener must be replaced, record part identification and reason for replacement in the maintenance record and update MM-P2-L4-HT02 as applicable.

Records to keep
- Maintenance log entry for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 including:
  - Technician(s) name and signature.
  - Reference to MM-P2-L4-HT02 and SOP-P2-L4-01 or SOP-P2-L4-04 as applicable.
  - Fastener locations inspected and status (OK, replaced, reworked).
  - Lubricant applied: CFW-LUB-426 where used.
  - Findings from dye-penetrant or magnifier inspections.
  - Any deviations from procedure and corrective actions taken.
- Calibration certificate reference for the torque wrench used.
- Replacement fastener part numbers and batch/traceability information if parts were changed.
- Any follow-up actions scheduled in the CMMS with reference to this document id.

Acceptance criteria
- All inspected fasteners show no signs of structural damage, cracking, or excessive corrosion that would impair function.
- Fasteners on process-critical assemblies are seated and tightened per the sequence in MM-P2-L4-HT02 and verified using a calibrated torque wrench. Where lubrication was applied, the lubricant used is CFW-LUB-426 and recorded.
- Assemblies affecting the quench function do not introduce measurable gaps or distortions that could alter the quench path or timing; recall that the quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 10 seconds. Any condition that could cause quench delay beyond this requirement must be corrected prior to return to service.
- All inspection and torque actions are recorded and traceable in the maintenance log and CMMS with references to MM-P2-L4-HT02, SOP-P2-L4-01, and SOP-P2-L4-04.

References
- MM-P2-L4-HT02
- SOP-P2-L4-01
- SOP-P2-L4-04
